results.corrected_title: UK CMA says consumer law applies to personal AI agents as Meta launches Muse in the UK
results.corrected_summary: On 24 November 2026, the day Meta's Muse AI agent launched in the UK, the CMA published a statement. It says UK consumer protection law applies to AI products, including personal AI agents. Suppliers must be clear and not misleading, must address the risks of agents, and must give users information and easy controls over access and autonomy. The CMA says Meta changed its terms and conditions after CMA engagement. Talks with Meta are continuing. The CMA and ICO also issued joint tips for people who use AI agents.
key_facts: CMA statement dated 2026-11-24, the UK launch day of Meta Muse
Consumer law applies to personal AI agents
Providers must disclose risks and limits, and give users easy controls over agent access and autonomy
Meta changed its terms after CMA engagement; the statement does not say what changed
CMA and ICO jointly issued user tips
results.issues: Only CMA statement opened. ICO's role is joint user tips, not a separate statement.

results.corrected_title: Anthropic and OpenAI each post unreviewed Lean-formalized proofs that VP != VNP
results.corrected_summary: Anthropic published a paper and Lean 4 formalization titled 'VP != VNP over every field', which it says were written by Claude and found by an internal research model. Per ThursdAI, OpenAI posted its own proof about five hours later on 2026-11-23. Neither proof has been checked by human mathematicians or peer reviewed. Anthropic's repository says no human mathematician has checked the proof and that the result does not resolve P vs NP.
key_facts: Anthropic's repository (anthropics/formal-math, branch vp-vnp) holds the paper and Lean 4 formalization
An internal research Claude model found the result; AI models wrote paper and Lean code
No human mathematician has checked the proof
The 2026-11-23 date and the OpenAI proof 'about five hours later' come only from ThursdAI (single source)
Result does not resolve P vs NP
results.issues: GitHub page shows no date; date and OpenAI proof rely on ThursdAI alone.

results.corrected_title: ElevenLabs reportedly in early talks to raise at a $33B valuation
results.corrected_summary: SiliconANGLE, citing Bloomberg, reports on 2026-11-25 that ElevenLabs is in early talks for new funding at a $33 billion valuation. Its most recent raise was at $22 billion. The report says the round could close in Q1 2027. ElevenLabs' annualized recurring revenue is about $700 million, up $100 million since September.
key_facts: $33B valuation is from early talks, not a closed round
ARR about $700M, up $100M since September (Bloomberg via SiliconANGLE)
results.issues: Bloomberg original not opened. Kotoba price single-sourced (Nikkei).

results.corrected_title: Anthropic begins rolling out 'Install as app' beta for Claude artifacts on desktop
results.corrected_summary: On 2026-11-24, Anthropic began rolling out a beta feature that lets users install Claude artifacts as desktop apps on Mac and Windows. Users must be online and signed in to Claude Desktop, and Enterprise owners must enable it for their workspace.
key_facts: Beta; Mac and Windows via Claude Desktop
Users must be online and signed in; Enterprise owners must enable it (Besthunt)
